Selectively measuring endpoint 1 in the computational basis gives either Z2-corrected C3 path on 234 tensor a pure endpoint; its three retained pairs each have I=1 (including 24 via product of endpoint stabilizers). Each branch hence sums 3, M=1/2; both branches have probability 1/2. Direct independent GF(2) support-enumeration reconstructed these exact pairwise MI values. It is an analytical finite-dimensional counterexample, not extrapolation.
